jobs.description_md:
**Student Assistant, Data & Analytics at Svitzer Head Office**

**Are you studying data, analytics, or business and want hands-on experience with a modern data platform in a global company? Svitzer has a student position in an international setting where you can keep developing professionally and personally. As a Student Assistant in the Data Platform & Insight team, you'll help build and improve the dashboards and analytics solutions that colleagues across a global maritime business use every day and help more people get value from our data.**

**We offer**

You will join a global leader in towage. Svitzer has 4,400 colleagues and 510 tugboats in 35+ countries, and it provides marine services that make ports and terminals safer, more efficient and more climate friendly. We are building a unified data platform to support better decisions, operational efficiency, and digital innovation. You will work in a role where data, business, and technology meet, and your work will be visible across the organization.

The role is based at our Head Office (HQ) in Nordhavn in Copenhagen, in the central Data Platform & Insight team. We are a lean team with a flat structure, so you will have real independence to shape your role and make an impact from day one.

Svitzer HQ has a strong student community, with social events and regular lunches together.

Your hours are flexible, especially around exams. On average, we expect you to work 15–20 hours per week.

**Key responsibilities**

You will work closely with our two Data & Analytics Partners, who link business stakeholders with the Data Platform team. Together with them, your main responsibility will be our dashboards, reporting and analytics solutions, both local and global, with one clear goal: more people using data from the Data Platform, and using it more effectively.

Within this area, you will:

* Build and improve dashboards and reports: build, update and improve dashboards and reports in Insight, our Power BI-based reporting solution. Use user feedback and usage data to make them easier to use and more valuable.

* Support global solutions: help develop and improve our global, centrally managed reporting and analytics solutions, together with the Data & Analytics Partners and Data Engineers.

* Support local solutions: help business areas build and improve local reports and self-service solutions based on trusted data from the Data Platform, so they can find answers themselves.

* Drive adoption and training: create training material, user guides and onboarding content, and help run training sessions that give colleagues the confidence to use data in their daily work.

* Track and report on usage: monitor how our solutions are used, spot where uptake is low and suggest improvements that lead to wider and better use of data.

* Test and validate: support user acceptance testing (UAT), check data accuracy and document KPI definitions and business rules.

* Be part of the team rhythm: join daily stand-ups, help coordinate incoming requests and incidents related to reports and dashboards, and keep users informed about progress.

**Who we are looking for**

* You already reside in Denmark and have a valid visa- and work permit (this is a must).
* You are in the 3rd year of a bachelor's degree, or taking a master's degree, in Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a similar field.
* You have experience with Power BI or similar tools, and strong Excel skills. SQL, DAX or Python skills are a strong plus .
* You have a genuine interest in data, dashboards and data visualization, and in how they create business value.
* You are curious and self-driven, and you bring energy and a structured, analytical approach to your work.

* You enjoy taking ownership and seeing tasks through to the end.

* You stay organized when you are handling several requests at once, and you like keeping others informed.

* You think about the user first, and you're motivated by making solutions that people actually use.

* You enjoy explaining data in simple terms and helping others build their skills through training and guidance.

* You enjoy taking ownership and see tasks through to the end.

* Relevant work experience, for example from a previous student job, is an advantage.

* You thrive in a busy, dynamic environment and are motivated by the international scope of our business.
* Our working language is English, so you must be fluent in written and spoken English. Danish is a plus but not a requirement.

**Deadline**

***26 October 2026.*** To ensure a consistent and fair recruitment process, applications must be submitted via the “Apply” button in our recruitment system, Workday. Applications submitted outside the system will unfortunately not be considered.

**Contact information**

For more information about the position, contact Jonas Aagaard Quist, Head of Data Platform and Cloud Services, at jonas.aagaard.quist@svitzer.com.

**Building a Diverse Workplace**

In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

**How to Apply**

To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

**Job Description & Summary**

**Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med økonomistyring, transformation og performance management i nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder? Vil du være med til at løse komplekse problemstillinger tæt på CFO'en og få ansvar fra dag ét?** 
Så bliv graduate i PwC's Finance Excellence og kickstart din karriere som konsulent!

I Finance Excellence hjælper vi virksomheder med at skabe bedre beslutningsgrundlag, stærkere økonomifunktioner og mere effektive processer. Som graduate bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med både drift, udvikling og transformation af finansfunktionen hos vores kunder.

**Vi sætter dig i førerposition fra starten**

Den 1. september 2027 starter dit graduate-forløb i Finance Excellence, når du slutter dig til vores afdeling og et stærkt hold af gode kolleger med forskellige baggrunde inden for økonomi, finans, regnskab og forretningsudvikling. Du bliver fastansat i afdelingen og gennem de næste to år bliver du klædt på til rollen som konsulent gennem praktisk erfaring, sparring med erfarne kolleger og et skræddersyet udviklingsforløb.

Derudover får du din egen career coach, som støtter din faglige og personlige udvikling gennem graduateforløbet og videre i din karriere hos PwC.

**Bliv en del af Finance Excellence i Consulting**

Finance Excellence samler PwC's kompetencer inden for CFO-rådgivning og CFO-services. Fælles for vores arbejde er, at vi hjælper virksomheder med at udvikle, styrke og drive deres økonomifunktioner.

Som graduate får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af markedets dygtigste specialister og rådgive virksomheder om alt fra daglig økonomistyring og controlling til større transformationsprogrammer og implementering af nye styringsmodeller.

”*I Finance Excellence er der stor fokus på din faglige og personlige udvikling, hvilket understøttes af en stor variation af arbejdsopgaver, diverse kurser og sociale arrangementer. Overgangen fra studerende til fuldtidsansat gik overraskende nemt pga. det unge miljø i afdelingen*," fortæller Jonas, der er tidligere graduate hos PwC i Hellerup.

Afhængigt af hvilket spor du vælger, vil du enten arbejde som en integreret del af kundens organisation eller som rådgiver på strategiske og transformationstunge projekter.

**Vælg dit spor: CFO Service, CFO Service Payroll eller CFO Advisory**

Når du søger graduateprogrammet, skal du i din ansøgning angive, hvilket af nedenstående områder du ønsker at blive en del af.

* **CFO Service:** Som graduate i CFO Service arbejder du på interim basis ude hos kunder. Du træder ind som en konsulent, når kunden har brug for ekstra kapacitet eller specialiserede kompetencer, og du bliver hurtigt en integreret del af organisationen. Du får praktisk erfaring med blandt andet økonomistyring, controlling, rapportering, procesoptimering og projektarbejde og udvikler dermed en stærk faglig værktøjskasse. Samtidig lærer du at forstå virksomheden indefra, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og omsætte dine analyser til konkrete løsninger, som implementeres i tæt samarbejde med kunden.
* **CFO Service Payroll:** Som graduate i CFO Service Payroll arbejder du primært på interim basis ude hos kunder. Du vil arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem HR og Finans – og med fokus på at blive specialist inden for lønområdet. Du vil komme til at træde ind som konsulent hos kunderne, når der er behov for ekstra ressourcer eller specifikke kompetencer indenfor payroll efterspørges. Du vil få praktisk erfaring med blandt andet lønadministration, controlling, design og optimering af processer samt projektarbejde. Fokus vil være på specialisering inden for et område, hvor udvikling fra operationel funktion til sparringspartner sker hurtigt.
* **CFO Advisory:** Som graduate i CFO Advisory bliver du en del af projekthold, der rådgiver virksomheder om, hvordan de udvikler fremtidens økonomifunktion. Du kommer til at hjælpe kunder med blandt andet operating models, styringsmodeller, planlægningsprocesser, performance management og implementering af nye løsninger. Her er fokus på analyse, transformation og strategisk rådgivning.

**Et stærkt fællesskab og gode kolleger, der bliver nye venner**

I Finance Excellence kombinerer vi høj faglighed med et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, sparring og videndeling.

Du får ansvar tidligt i din karriere, men står aldrig alene. Uanset om du arbejder ude hos kunder eller på interne projekter, vil du altid have erfarne kolleger omkring dig, som hjælper dig med at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Samtidigt bliver du en del af PwC's graduatefællesskab på tværs af huset, hvor du deltager i onboarding, netværksaktiviteter og faglige udviklingsforløb sammen med de øvrige graduates.

**Er du ved at afslutte din kandidat og klar til næste skridt?**

Så længe du (snart) har en kandidat inden for regnskab, økonomi, finans eller lignende og er klar på at lære en masse, klæder vi dig godt på til resten. Din nysgerrighed og lyst til at tilegne dig viden, forventes at være din største drivkraft. Men det er også vigtigt, at du har lyst til at opbygge relationer og er en teamplayer, der ser opgaveløsningen som en holdindsats.

**Klar til at kickstarte din karriere?**

... så ansøg via linket og husk at angive om du søger CFO Service eller CFO Advisory. Du finder svar på de mest almindelige spørgsmål i vores [FAQ](http://www.pwc.dk/graduates#faq).

Finder du ikke et svar på dit spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen på natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

Deadline er 18. oktober, og samtaler er planlagt i november.

# Become a Graduate in PwC's Finance Excellence and Step Into the Role of Advisor to Tomorrow's CFOs

**Would you like to work with financial management, transformation, and performance management in some of Denmark's largest companies? Do you want to help solve complex business challenges close to the CFO and take on responsibility from day one?**

Then join PwC's Finance Excellence graduate programme and kickstart your career as a consultant!

In Finance Excellence, we help companies build stronger foundations for decision-making, more effective finance functions, and streamlined processes. As a graduate, you will become part of a highly professional environment where you will have the opportunity to work with both the operation, development, and transformation of our clients' finance functions.

**Take the Lead From Day One**

On 1 September 2027, you will begin your graduate journey in Finance Excellence, joining our team of talented colleagues with diverse backgrounds in accounting, finance, economics, and business development.

You will be permanently employed in the department and, over the next two years, be prepared for a consulting career through hands-on experience, sparring with experienced colleagues, and a tailored development programme.

In addition, you will be assigned your own Career Coach, who will support your professional and personal development throughout the graduate programme and beyond as your career progresses at PwC.

**Join Finance Excellence in Consulting**

Finance Excellence brings together PwC's expertise in CFO Advisory and CFO Services. What unites our work is helping organisations develop, strengthen, and operate their finance functions.

As a graduate, you will have the opportunity to work closely with some of the market's leading specialists and advise clients on everything from day-to-day financial management and controlling to large-scale transformation programmes and the implementation of new performance management frameworks.

"*In Finance Excellence, there is a strong focus on both professional and personal development, supported by a wide variety of assignments, training courses, and social events. The transition from student to full-time employee was surprisingly smooth thanks to the young and welcoming environment in the department,"* says Jonas, a former graduate at PwC in Hellerup.

Depending on the track you choose, you will either work as an integrated part of a client's organisation or as an advisor on strategic and transformation-focused projects.

**Choose Your Track: CFO Service or CFO Advisory**

When applying for the graduate programme, please indicate in your application which of the following areas you would like to join.

* CFO Service: As a graduate in CFO Service, you will work on an interim basis at client organisations. You will step in as a consultant when clients need additional capacity or specialised expertise and quickly become an integrated part of their organisation. You will gain hands-on experience within financial management, controlling, reporting, process optimisation, and project management, building a strong professional toolbox in the process. At the same time, you will learn to understand businesses from the inside, identify improvement opportunities, and turn your analyses into tangible solutions that are implemented in close collaboration with the client.
* CFO Service Payroll: As a graduate in CFO Service Payroll, you will primarily work on an interim basis at client organizations. You’ll operate at the intersection of HR and Finance, with a strong focus on becoming a specialist in payroll. You will step in as a consultant for clients when there is a need for additional resources or specific competencies within payroll. You will gain hands on experience within payroll administration, controlling, process design and optimization, as well as project work. The focus will be on specializing in an area that quickly evolves from an operational function to a sparring partner in the market we see ahead.
* CFO Advisory: As a graduate in CFO Advisory, you will join project teams that advise organisations on how to build and develop the finance function of the future. You will support clients with areas such as operating models, governance frameworks, planning processes, performance management, and the implementation of new solutions. The focus is on analysis, transformation, and strategic advisory services.

**A Strong Community and Great Colleagues Who Become Friends**

At Finance Excellence, we combine professional excellence with a strong sense of community. We believe the best results are achieved through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous sparring.

You will take on responsibility early in your career, but you will never stand alone. Whether you are working on-site with clients or on internal projects, you will always be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are committed to helping you grow both professionally and personally.

At the same time, you will become part of PwC's graduate community across the firm, participating in onboarding activities, networking events, and development programmes alongside fellow graduates.

**Are You Finishing Your Master's Degree and Ready for the Next Step?**

As long as you have, or will soon obtain, a Master's degree in accounting, economics, finance, or a related field, and are eager to learn, we will provide you with the tools you need to succeed.

Your curiosity and desire to continuously expand your knowledge are expected to be your strongest drivers. Equally important is your ability to build relationships and your mindset as a team player who sees solving client challenges as a collective effort.

**Ready to Kickstart Your Career?**

Apply via the link and remember to indicate whether you are applying for CFO Service or CFO Advisory. If you have any questions, please contact Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen at natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

The application deadline is 18 October, and interviews are scheduled to take place in November.

**Application Checklist**

* Upload your Bachelor's and Master's academic transcripts

**Job Description & Summary**

**Kunne du tænke dig at starte din karriere i en rolle, hvor du bliver eksponeret for mange forskellige typer af opgaver? Og vil du have mulighed for at forme din karriere som konsulent inden for et fagområde, der matcher dine interesser og ambitioner?**

Så bliv graduate i PwC’s Consulting. Her venter et væld af muligheder, et højt fagligt niveau og et stærkt fællesskab, som sikrer, at du kommer til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

*"Som graduate får du den bedste start på din karriere som konsulent. Samtidig bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med andre graduates og får mulighed for at opbygge et netværk på tværs af PwC. Det giver et stærkt fundament for din udvikling både fagligt og personligt,"* fortæller Emily, People & Culture Lead i Consulting.

**Kom godt fra start**

Den 1. september 2027 starter dit graduate-forløb i Consulting, når du slutter dig til vores afdeling og et stærkt hold af gode kolleger med forskellige baggrunde. Fra dag ét bliver du en integreret del af dit team og får hurtigt ansvar på spændende kundeprojekter, hvor du lærer gennem praktisk erfaring og tæt samarbejde med erfarne konsulenter. Du bliver fastansat i afdelingen og gennem de næste to år bliver du klædt på til rollen som konsulent gennem praktisk erfaring, sparring med erfarne kolleger og et skræddersyet udviklingsforløb.

Derudover får du din egen career coach, som støtter din faglige og personlige udvikling gennem graduateforløbet og videre i din karriere hos PwC.

**Dyk ned i rollen som konsulent**

Som graduate bliver du en del af ét af vores fagområder i Consulting, hvor du fra dag ét arbejder tæt sammen med kunder og kolleger om at løse komplekse forretningsmæssige udfordringer.

Hverdagen som konsulent er varieret. Du analyserer problemstillinger, udvikler løsninger og faciliterer workshops. Samtidig får du mulighed for at opbygge dyb ekspertise inden for det område, der interesserer dig mest.

Når du søger stillingen, beder vi dig derfor angive, hvilket af nedenstående områder du ønsker at blive en del af, og hvor du vurderer, at din profil passer bedst ind.

* **Strategy & Transformation Excellence:** Vil du være med til at hjælpe virksomheder med at definere strategier for forskellige enheder i både det private og offentlige samt gennemføre de efterfølgende transformationer? Vi arbejder med strategiudvikling, program- og projektledelse samt forretningstransformation i virksomheders og organisationers operationelle værdikæde. Derudover har vi specialister, der er særligt fokuserede på energisektoren, forsvar og forsvarsindustrien samt sundheds- og pharmaområderne.
* **Technology, AI & Data Excellence:** Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens organisationer og omsætte ny teknologi til reel forretningsværdi? Hos os rådgiver du både private virksomheder og offentlige organisationer i at omsætte komplekse digitale og teknologiske ambitioner til konkrete forretningsgevinster. Du vil komme til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, strategi, forretning og innovation og er med til at skabe moderne, skalerbare og fremtidssikrede løsninger, der styrker virksomheder og offentlige organisationer.
* **Cyber Excellence:** Vil du hjælpe virksomheder med at beskytte deres forretning i en stadig mere digital verden? Vi rådgiver om cyber- og informationssikkerhed, digitale risici, compliance og robuste sikkerhedsløsninger. Arbejdet spænder fra sikkerhedsstrategi og GRC til implementering af tekniske og organisatoriske sikkerhedstiltag.
* **Risk Excellence:** Vil du arbejde med risikostyring og skabe tillid i komplekse organisationer? Vi hjælper kunder med governance, compliance, regulering, treasury, opklaring af svindel samt opbygning af robuste kontrolmiljøer, så de kan navigere i en dynamisk verden med stigende risici og krav til transparens og ansvarlighed.

**Et stærkt fællesskab og gode kolleger, der bliver nye venner**

I Consulting kombinerer vi høj faglighed med et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, sparring og videndeling. Du får ansvar tidligt i din karriere, men står aldrig alene. Uanset om du arbejder ude hos kunder eller på interne projekter, vil du altid have erfarne kolleger omkring dig, som hjælper dig med at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Samtidigt bliver du en del af PwC's graduatefællesskab på tværs af huset, hvor du deltager i onboarding, netværksaktiviteter og faglige udviklingsforløb sammen med de øvrige graduates.

**Er du ved at afslutte din kandidat og klar til næste skridt?**

Grib chancen og start på det forløb, der passer dig bedst. Så længe du har en kandidat, er vi åbne for din baggrund. Din nysgerrighed og lyst til at tilegne dig viden, forventes at være din største drivkraft. Men det er også vigtigt, at du har lyst til at opbygge relationer og er en teamplayer, der ser opgaveløsningen som en holdindsats.

**Klar til at kickstarte din karriere?**

... så ansøg via linket og husk at angive hvilket spor du er interreseret i. Du finder svar på de mest almindelige spørgsmål i vores [FAQ](http://www.pwc.dk/graduates#faq).

Finder du ikke et svar på dit spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen på natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

Deadline er 18. oktober, og samtaler er planlagt i november.

* Angiv om du har præference for at arbejde i Hellerup eller Århus.

# Become a Graduate in PwC Consulting and Step Into the Role of Consultant

**Would you like to start your career in a role that exposes you to a wide variety of projects and challenges? And would you like the opportunity to shape your consulting career within a field that matches your interests and ambitions?**

Then join PwC's Consulting graduate programme. Here, you'll find a world of opportunities, a high level of professional excellence, and a strong sense of community, all designed to support your growth both professionally and personally.

*"As a graduate, you get the best possible start to your consulting career. At the same time, you become part of a strong community of fellow graduates and have the opportunity to build a network across PwC. This creates a solid foundation for your development, both professionally and personally,"* says Emily, People & Culture Lead in Consulting.

**Get Off to a Great Start**

On 1 September 2027, you will begin your graduate journey in Consulting, joining our department and a strong team of talented colleagues with diverse backgrounds. From day one, you will become an integrated member of your team and quickly take on responsibility in exciting client engagements, learning through hands-on experience and close collaboration with experienced consultants. You will be permanently employed in the department, and over the next two years, you will be prepared for a consulting career through practical experience, sparring with experienced colleagues, and a tailored development programme.

In addition, you will be assigned your own Career Coach, who will support your professional and personal development throughout the graduate programme and beyond as your career progresses at PwC.

**Dive Into the Role of a Consultant**

As a graduate, you will join one of our Consulting teams, where you will work closely with clients and colleagues from day one to solve complex business challenges. No two days are the same as a consultant. You will analyse challenges, develop solutions, and facilitate workshops. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise within the area that interests you the most.

When applying, we therefore ask you to indicate which of the following areas you would like to join and where you believe your profile is the best fit.

* **Strategy & Transformation Excellence:** Would you like to help organisations define strategies across both the private and public sectors and lead the transformations that bring those strategies to life? We work with strategy development, programme and project management, and business transformation across organisations' operational value chains. In addition, we have specialists with particular expertise in the energy sector, defence and defence industries, as well as the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors.
* **Technology, AI & Data Excellence:** Would you like to shape the organisations of the future and turn emerging technologies into real business value? We advise both private companies and public-sector organisations on transforming complex digital and technological ambitions into tangible business outcomes. You will work at the intersection of technology, strategy, business, and innovation, helping to create modern, scalable, and future-proof solutions that empower organisations to succeed.
* **Cyber Excellence:** Would you like to help organisations protect their businesses in an increasingly digital world? We advise clients on cyber and information security, digital risk, compliance, and resilient security solutions. Our work ranges from security strategy and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) to the implementation of technical and organisational security measures.
* **Risk Excellence:** Would you like to work with risk management and help build trust in complex organisations? We support clients with governance, compliance, regulation, treasury, fraud investigations, and the development of robust control environments, enabling them to navigate a dynamic world with increasing risks and growing expectations for transparency and accountability.

**A Strong Community and Great Colleagues Who Become Friends**

In Consulting, we combine professional excellence with a strong sense of community. We believe the best results are achieved through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous sparring. You will take on responsibility early in your career, but you will never stand alone. Whether you are working on-site with clients or on internal projects, you will always be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are committed to helping you develop both professionally and personally.  At the same time, you will become part of PwC's graduate community across the firm, participating in onboarding activities, networking events, and development programmes alongside fellow graduates.

**Are You Finishing Your Master's Degree and Ready for the Next Step?**

Seize the opportunity and start the graduate journey that suits you best. As long as you hold, or are about to complete, a Master's degree, we are open to your educational background. Your curiosity and desire to continuously learn are expected to be your greatest strengths. Equally important is your ability to build relationships and your mindset as a team player who views solving challenges as a collective effort.

**Ready to Kickstart Your Career?**

Apply via the link and remember to indicate which track you are interested in.  If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Talent Attraction Advisor Natasha Berthelsen at natasha.berthelsen@pwc.com.

The application deadline is 18 October, and interviews are scheduled to take place in November.

* Indicate whether you have a preference for working in Hellerup or Aarhus

jobs.title: Student Assistant, Netcompany Institute
jobs.description_md:
*How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.*

*Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.*

**Responsibilities**

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

* Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe
* Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices
* Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready
* Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

**How we work with AI**

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

**About you**

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

* Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.
* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.
* Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.
* Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies
* Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

**Continue developing with us**

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community**

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application**

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

*All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.*

*We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1*

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. ##

October 18th, 2026

I Tax & Legal er kunstig intelligens en integreret del af den måde, vi arbejder på. Vi bruger AI til at understøtte og effektivisere arbejdsprocesser, analysere store datamængder og skabe endnu større værdi for vores kunder. Som graduate hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med moderne AI-værktøjer og være med til at forme fremtidens rådgivning inden for skat og jura.

**Et stærkt fællesskab og gode kolleger, der bliver nye venner**

I Tax & Legal kombinerer vi høj faglighed med et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, sparring og videndeling.

Du får ansvar tidligt i din karriere, men står aldrig alene. Uanset om du arbejder ude hos kunder eller på interne projekter, vil du altid have erfarne kolleger omkring dig, som hjælper dig med at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Samtidigt bliver du en del af PwC's graduatefællesskab på tværs af huset, hvor du deltager i onboarding, netværksaktiviteter og faglige udviklingsforløb sammen med de øvrige graduates.

**Er du ved at afslutte din kandidat og klar til næste skridt?**

Så længe du (snart) har en kandidat inden for erhvervsjura, jura eller økonomi og er klar på en stejl læringskurve, klæder vi dig godt på til resten.

Det vigtigste er din nysgerrighed – både over for vores kunder og arbejdsopgaver. Ud over at være opsøgende og god til at opbygge relationer, lægger vi vægt på, at du har en stærk lyst til at lære og udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Vi værdsætter, når medarbejdere betragter hver opgave som en mulighed for udvikling og ser opgaveløsningen som en holdindsats.

**Become a Tax & Legal Graduate at PwC and step into the role of a consultant**

*Would you like to explore tax law, finance, and legal topics? And do you want to see how both large and small companies across Denmark operate?*

Become a graduate at PwC and jump straight into the role of consultant. Over the next 2 years, you will develop your professional toolbox, continuously gain more responsibility while working on projects, and build close relationships with clients and colleagues.

**We empower you to take the lead from day one**

Your graduate programme begins on September 1, 2027, where you will join a team of 300 colleagues in our Tax & Legal organisation. You will be employed in one of our 8 departments, and over the next 2 years, we will prepare you for the role of a consultant through knowledge sharing, courses and practical experience.

Initially, you and the other graduates will get to know each other, and you will receive a thorough introduction to our company and the tasks awaiting you. You will also be given a career coach who will support you – this continues after the graduate programme when you continue your career at PwC.

*“The graduate programme provides an excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth. You get involved in exciting projects, work on complex challenges, and take on responsibility early on, making every day both rewarding and motivating,”* says Kristina, Shipping, Oil & Energy.

**Act as a consultant on financial, economic, and legal tasks**

In Tax & Legal, we help clients in the Danish business community across a wide range of legal areas and nearly all aspects of tax law. You can look forward to tackling a variety of different tasks. The exact tasks you will work on depend on which department you become part of:

* Compliance & Wealth – working at the intersection of corporate and personal tax.
* Deals Tax – working with private equity clients and M&A transactions.
* Indirect Taxes – working with VAT, customs, and excise duties.
* Business Tax – working with corporate tax, restructuring, succession planning, and property tax.
* International Tax Services - working with international tax matters for Danish and multinational corporations, as well as foundations, private equity, and financial companies.
* Transfer Pricing – working with multinational companies' cross-border transactions.
* Shipping, Oil & Energy (only in Hellerup) – working with energy, oil, and shipping companies.
* Legal – working with corporate and commercial law as well as M&A.

As a consultant, you will work very independently, but we solve tasks in teams, so you will also work with colleagues from other areas within PwC.

In Tax & Legal, artificial intelligence is an integral part of the way we work. We use AI to support and streamline work processes, analyse large volumes of data, and create even greater value for our clients. As a graduate with us, you will have the opportunity to work with modern AI tools and help shape the future of tax and legal advisory services.

**A strong community and great colleagues who become friends**

In Tax & Legal, we combine our expertise with a strong sense of community. We believe the best results are created through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous sparring with colleagues.

You will be given responsibility early in your career, but you will never be on your own. Whether you are working on client engagements or internal projects, you will always be surrounded by experienced colleagues who support and challenge you, helping you grow both professionally and personally.

At the same time, you will become part of PwC’s graduate community across the firm, taking part in onboarding activities, networking events, and professional development programmes alongside fellow graduates.

**Are you about to finish your master’s degree and ready to kick-start your career?**

As long as you (are about to) hold a master's degree in business law, law, or economics and are prepared for a steep learning curve, we will ensure you are well-equipped for the rest.

What matters most is your curiosity, both about our clients and the challenges you take on. Alongside a proactive mindset and strong relationship-building skills, we look for a genuine eagerness to learn and grow, both professionally and personally. We value people who view every assignment as an opportunity to develop and who understand that the best results are achieved through teamwork.

**Ready to kickstart your career?**

…then apply via the link. If you have questions, feel free to contact Helena Fjord at helena.holmberg.fjord@pwc.com.

**Application deadline:** October 18, 2026.

Application checklist:

**Job Description & Summary**

*Kunne du tænke dig at træde ind i rollen som konsulent og arbejde med virksomhedsopkøb, frasalg og integrationer? Og vil du samtidig lære, hvordan virksomheder og investorer skaber værdi før, under og efter en transaktion?*

Så bliv graduate i PwC’s Deals Carve-out & Merger Integration team (Delivering Deal Value) og vær med til at rådgive virksomheder gennem nogle af deres mest komplekse forandringer. Her får du et væld af muligheder, et højt fagligt niveau og et stærkt fællesskab, som sikrer, at du udvikler dig fagligt og personligt. Du vil opnå erfaring på tværs af forskellige forretningsområder, hvilket giver dig en bred forståelse af de relevante processer i forbindelse med virksomhedstransaktioner.

**Din udvikling er supporteret af PwC’s graduateprogram**

Den 1. september 2027 starter dit 2-årige graduateforløb i vores Deals-afdeling. Her starter du og de andre graduates ud med en grundig introduktion til PwC, teamet og de opgaver, der venter dig. Som graduate bliver du fastansat i afdelingen, og vi sørger for at klæde dig godt på til rollen som konsulent gennem videndeling, skræddersyede kursusprogrammer og praktisk erfaring.

**Arbejdet i PwC Deals**

Som graduate i Deals bliver du en del af en ung og dynamisk afdeling på mere end 110 dygtige kolleger. Her kommer du til at arbejde med flere aspekter af virksomhedsopkøb og -salg og lærer samtidig, hvordan du kan bidrage med værdifuld rådgivning til beslutningstagere i både private equity fonde og virksomheder.

PwC Deals består primært af tre forskellige fagområder, som du vælger på forhånd og bliver i forløbet igennem: Transaction Services, Valuation and Modelling samt Delivering Deal Value. Hvert fagområde håndterer interaktioner med sælgere, købere og andre potentielle stakeholders afhængigt af transaktionens fase, kompleksitet og de behov, der opstår undervejs i processen.

Undervejs får du indblik i, hvordan virksomheder integreres, adskilles og transformeres som en del af M&A-transaktioner.

**Et godt fællesskab og gode kolleger**

Hos PwC bliver du en del af en markedsledende virksomhed, hvor vi gør tingene ordentligt. Her får du mulighed for at træde ind i et powerhouse af viden, som du får rig mulighed for at suge til dig.

Som en del af vores team får du ikke kun mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af de mest spændende og komplekse transaktioner, men også at udvikle dig i et miljø præget af samarbejde og fælles ambitioner.

jobs.title: Student Assistant, AI & Digital Acceleration, Novonesis
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you curious about Artificial Intelligence, digital transformation, and how technology can create business value?

At Novonesis, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Digital & AI Acceleration team within Food & Beverages Biosolutions (FBB). Working closely with leaders driving the AI and Digital agenda, you will help accelerate AI adoption, support digital transformation initiatives, and contribute to AI-powered solutions that create business impact. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of technology, innovation, and business in a global organization.

**The role & your impact**

As a Student Assistant, you will support AI adoption, digital transformation, and AI solution development across FBB. You will contribute to both strategic initiatives and day-to-day execution, helping turn ideas into measurable business outcomes.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Support AI and digital adoption activities across the organization.
* Create communication, training, and enablement materials.
* Support workshops, learning activities, and best-practice sharing.
* Contribute to the development, testing, and improvement of AI and digital solutions.
* Assist with stakeholder communication, meeting preparation, reporting, and progress tracking.
* Support data collection, dashboards, documentation, and operational activities.

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

* Currently pursuing a Master's degree within business, technology, engineering, data science, biotechnology, life sciences, innovation, digital transformation, or a related field.
* Preferably at least 1.5 years remaining before completing your studies.
* Strong interest in AI, digital technologies, and business transformation.
* Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented approach to work.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Comfortable working with data and technology, including analyzing information, identifying insights, and exploring digital, AI, or low-code/no-code solutions to solve business challenges.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

* Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies.
* Experience with coding, data science, data engineering, AI solution development, or related technical disciplines is considered an advantage.
* Experience creating presentations, training content, or communication materials.
* Interest in change management and technology adoption.

**What we offer you**

At Novonesis, you will join a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where learning and development are part of everyday work. You will work closely with leaders driving the AI and Digital agenda within FBB and gain hands-on experience with Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, AI Agents, and digital solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to build skills within AI adoption, project management, change management, and business transformation while collaborating with stakeholders across a global organization.

**Working conditions**

The position is based in Lyngby and Hørsholm, Denmark. The expected workload is approximately 10-15 hours per week, with flexibility around exam periods and study commitments. Regular presence in either office is expected, combined with the opportunity to work from home as agreed with the team. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic international environment, enjoys learning new things, and takes a hands-on approach to getting things done.

**Application deadline:** 18 October 2026

**Location:** Lyngby/Hørsholm, Denmark

**Contact information: Yushu Shen Drehn,** Digital & AI Strategy Lead - [YSE@novonesis.com](mailto:YSE@novonesis.com)

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).

jobs.title: Praktikant til P3 Brugerinvolvering, foråret 2027

P3 søger en praktikant til teamet ’*Tværgående indhold og Brugerinddragelse’* i DR UNG. Her arbejder vi på tværs af P3’s formater (Podcast, TV, radio, instagram, YouTube og DR.dk ) og sikrer, at vores indhold udvikles med værdifulde input fra dem, vi laver indhold til.

Vi får input fra vores brugere ved at afholde udviklingsworkshops rundt om i landet og på DR's lokationer. Vi tager blandt andet på festivaler, besøger højskoler, kollegier, gymnasier og efterskoler – og inviterer også unge til workshops på DR.

Som praktikant hos os vil du lære metoder til at designe workshops og researche efter relevante emner i målgruppen, som bliver til indhold på tværs af P3. Du vil også lære metoder til, hvordan input fra unge kan finjustere og videreudvikle fx en pitch eller et gennemsyn på en dokumentar, inden den udkommer.

Du bliver en del af et fast team, og får varierede opgaver, som aftales løbende ud fra dine interesser, kvalifikationer og kompetencer fra studiet. Typisk vil de være inden for følgende områder:

* Tilrettelæggelse og udvikling af kreative procesdesigns, der gør det relevant og sjovt for unge at deltage i workshops med P3.
* Koordinering, rekruttering og afvikling af workshops
* Analyse og kodning af inputs fra unge til brugbar feedback, der kan inspirere P3’s indholdsredaktioner.
* Ad hoc-opgaver relateret til teamets øvrige arbejde – herunder indhold til Instagram og løbende rekruttering af unge til workshops.

**Vi forestiller os, at du:**

* Er nysgerrig på andre mennesker og har mod på at tale med dem om svære, grænseoverskridende, men også lette emner.
* Kan forholde dig objektivt til den viden, du får.
* Har mod på at opsøge unge, som kan deltage i vores workshops.
* Gerne har kendskab til kvalitative og kvantitative metoder samt interviewteknikker, særligt rettet mod børn og unge.
* Har en god visuel forståelse, er stærk i PowerPoint og er rutineret i at kreere opslag til instagramstories

Under praktikforløbet får du stillet computer og andre nødvendige remedier til rådighed. Praktikken er som udgangspunkt mellem 30-37 timer om ugen med start midt januar 2027. Den er ulønnet og foregår i DR Byen i København. Det er et krav, at opholdet er en del af dit studieforløb – og at du kan få merit. Under forløbet vil du naturligvis kunne passe studiemæssige aktiviteter og holde sædvanlig ferie.

Efter ansøgningsfristen inviterer vi til samtale.

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

jobs.description_md:
**Videostærk studentermedhjælper til P3 Podcast & Satire**

P3 Podcast & Satire søger en studentermedhjælper, der er skarp til video, sikker i Premiere Pro og har blik for, hvad der fungerer på sociale medier.

P3 Podcast & Satire er et kreativt redaktionsmiljø, der laver nogle af P3’s største podcasts som **Tyran, Under Radaren, Galt Nok, Hvem er…, KUP, Bare Os, Med al respekt og Elskovspony**. På samme redaktion laver vi også P3’s satire til Instagram.

Vi arbejder aktivt med at udvikle podcast som både lyd- og videoformat og udgiver indhold på blandt andet DR Lyd, Instagram, YouTube og Spotify.

##

## **Ansvar og arbejdsopgaver**

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at klippe videoindhold fra vores podcasts. Du skal kunne finde de stærkeste øjeblikke i længere optagelser og omsætte dem til reels og andet shortform-indhold, der fungerer i et feed.

Derudover får du ansvar for en række faste opgaver på redaktionen, blandt andet KODA-rapportering.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

* klippe reels og andet videoindhold fra vores podcasts i Adobe Premiere Pro
* finde stærke øjeblikke i længere podcastoptagelser
* tekste og tilpasse video til forskellige platforme
* arbejde med hooks, tempo og dramaturgi
* rapportere musik til KODA
* løse andre praktiske opgaver på redaktionen

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med redaktører, producere, værter og resten af holdet på P3 Podcast & Satire.

## **Din profil**

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en videregående uddannelse og har erfaring med videoredigering.

Det er vigtigt, at du er **godt hjemme i Adobe Premiere Pro**, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har blik for, hvad der fungerer på Instagram, TikTok og YouTube. Det er en fordel, hvis du interesserer dig for podcast, journalistik, humor og populærkultur.

Som person er du proaktiv og struktureret med et blik for det sjove og kreative. Du har både lyst til at arbejde kreativt med video og kan sørge for, at de administrative opgaver bliver løst ordentligt og til tiden.

##

## **Vi tilbyder**

Du bliver en del af P3 Podcast & Satire i DR Byen og kommer tæt på produktionen af nogle af P3’s største podcasts og en redaktion, der arbejder med både podcast, video og satire.

Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine evner inden for videoredigering, sociale medier og podcast og bliver en del af et miljø med højt tempo, mange forskellige fagligheder og kort vej fra idé til udgivelse.

Og sidst men ikke mindst, bliver du en del af et sjovt og ambitiøst fællesskab med fart på.

##

## **Kontakt**

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Du kommer til at arbejde i DR Byen, som har metro lige til døren.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte **Redaktionsleder for P3 Podcast & Satire, Anders Stegger** på aris@dr.dk, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer. **Send også meget gerne eksempler på videoindhold, du selv har klippet.**

Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk. Du søger ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i højre side.

jobs.title: Praktikant til kommunikation og projekter i DI Byggeri
jobs.location: DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark København
jobs.description_md:
Er du nysgerrig, engageret og har du lyst til at arbejde med kommunikation, projektplanlægning og store branchearrangementer? Så søg praktikstillingen i DI Byggeri i forårssemestret.

DI Byggeri er Dansk Industris branchefællesskab for bygge- og anlægsbranchen. Vi repræsenterer hele værdikæden i byggeriet og arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer for branchens virksomheder gennem blandt andet politisk interessevaretagelse, viden, rådgivning, netværk og kurser.

Vi søger en praktikant, der vil være med til at planlægge og afvikle to af DI Byggeris strategiske arrangementer: **Byggeriets Årsdag** og **ByggePladsen på Folkemødet**.

Som praktikant bliver du en del af teamet Byggeregioner og Projekter. Du får konkrete opgaver og ansvar og bliver involveret i arbejdet hele vejen fra planlægning og koordinering til kommunikation og praktisk afvikling. Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med kollegaer i DI Byggeri samt med partnere og oplægsholdere.

**Det vil du arbejde med som praktikant**

Du får mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige dele af planlægningen og gennemførelsen af Byggeriets Årsdag og ByggePladsen på Folkemødet.

**Kommunikation og markedsføring:** herunder udvikling af hjemmeside, koordinere kommunikationsindsatser på de to arrangementer og udarbejde materiale til samarbejdspartnere, deltagere og oplægsholdere.

**Planlægning og koordinering:** bidrage til programplanlægningen, udarbejde drejebøger, holde overblik over aktiviteter, deadlines og leverancer og understøtte koordineringen af de mange opgaver, der skal gå op i en højere enhed frem mod arrangementerne.

**Afvikling:** løse praktiske opgaver før, under og efter arrangementerne, deltage i afviklingen af både Byggeriets Årsdag og Folkemødet.

**Hvem er du?**

Vi søger en studerende, der ønsker at udvikle sig fagligt og få praktisk erfaring med kommunikation, projektarbejde og arrangementer i Danmarks største arbejdsgiverorganisation.

Vi forestiller os, at du læser kommunikation, statskundskab eller en beslægtet uddannelse. Det afgørende er, at du har interesse for kommunikation, koordinering og arrangementer – og lyst til at omsætte planer til praksis.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

· kan formulere dig klart og målgrupperettet på skrift

· er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at holde overblik

· kan tage ansvar for egne opgaver og følge dem til dørs

· trives med både selvstændige opgaver og tæt samarbejde med andre

· har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære undervejs.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, tager ansvar og har lyst til at bidrage til, at to store arrangementer lykkes.

**Hvad kan vi tilbyde?**

Som praktikant i DI får du mulighed for at opnå værdifuld praktisk erfaring inden for dit studieområde.

I DI Byggeri får du særligt indblik i, hvordan en arbejdsgiverorganisation arbejder med at samle bygge- og anlægsbranchen om aktuelle dagsordener gennem større arrangementer.

Du bliver involveret i hele processen fra de første forberedelser til den praktiske afvikling. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver, som bruges i praksis, og arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kollegaer, der giver sparring undervejs.

Stillingen er en fuldtidspraktikstilling fra februar til udgangen af juni og skal kunne indgå som en del af din universitetsuddannelse. Praktikken er ulønnet, men du modtager en erkendtlighed på op til 3.770 kr. pr. måned. Du skal forvente ekstra arbejde i uge 14 & 15 og i uge 23 & 24.

Du skal selv indgå en praktikaftale med dit uddannelsessted. DI udarbejder desuden en praktikantaftale, som beskriver de konkrete vilkår for praktikopholdet.

Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du kan deltage i Folkemødet på Bornholm i hele ugen.

**Arbejdssted:**

Dansk Industri, Industriens Hus H.C. Andersens Boulevard 18 1553 København V

**Sådan søger du**

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest **d. 16. oktober**. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål til praktikstillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kathrine Hjort Gellert på 3377 3910 eller [kahg@di.dk](mailto:kahg@di.dk) .

**Om DI Byggeri**

DI Byggeri er det største branchefællesskab under Dansk Industri og repræsenterer omkring 6.700 virksomheder inden for byggeri, anlæg og byggeindustri. Medlemsvirksomhederne beskæftiger knap 120.000 medarbejdere i Danmark. DI Byggeri repræsenterer hele værdikæden – fra udførende enkeltmandsvirksomheder, store anlægsvirksomheder, entreprenører og bygherrer til rådgivere, producenter, forhandlere og leverandører af byggematerialer og digitale løsninger. Læs mere om DI Byggeri på: <https://www.danskindustri.dk/brancher/di-byggeri/om-di-byggeri/>

jobs.title: Universitetspraktikant til P3's musikredaktion (Forår 2027)
jobs.description_md:
Elsker du musik? Og vil du lære at formidle den, så vores lyttere kommer til at elske den lige så meget som dig? Så har du nu chancen for at blive praktikant på musikredaktionen på landets største radiokanal for unge mennesker.

Vi søger to praktikanter, der har lommerne fulde af idéer, hovedet fuld af musik og mod på at lære. Praktikanter, som ikke er bange for at sætte dem selv og deres idéer på spil.
På P3’s musikredaktion lever og ånder vi for at levere begejstret og kreativ musikformidling på lyd, og det skal vores nye praktikanter hjælpe os med!

Musikredaktionen på P3 Radio består af 11 daglige og ugentlige musikprogrammer, og vores praktikanter vil have deres primære gang på programmerne Popdatering og Crush.

Popdatering er P3’s bredeste musiktilbud, hvor vi hver dag sammen med lytterne dyrker kærligheden til den musik, der betyder noget og de sange der sætter sig i kroppen og bliver en del af vores liv. Livemusik er også en vigtig del af vores ambitioner for programmet, og du bliver en del af arbejdet med at udvikle og realisere nye idéer på det område.

Crush er vores daglige aftenprogram for de musiknysgerrige med fokus på den nyeste musik, som P3 spiller. Det er her, vi dyrker det musikalske vækstlag, og de artister, som er på vej frem. Især den danske musik har en særlig plads i Crush.

På begge programmer lærer du at formidle musik på en måde der rammer følelserne og begejstre. Du er en del af idéudviklingen, du researcher, redigerer lyd, vinkler historier, caster lyttere og du vil også få indsigt i musik-udvælgelsen til kanalens playlister.

Og så kommer du ikke mindst til konstant at tænke, tale og lytte til ny musik sammen med nogle af landets sødeste, sjoveste og dygtigste musikformidlere og (radio)mennesker.

Vi forventer, at du...

* elsker at lytte til og tale om musik
* kan forholde dig nuanceret til P3’s musikprofil
* ikke er bange for at prøve noget nyt, men også trives i mere rutinepræget opgaver
* synes det kunne være fedt at tale med lyttere
* selv kan tage initiativ og komme med kreative idéer

Til gengæld kommer du til at…

* Forme radioindhold fra idé til handling – hver dag
* Få erfaring med at udvælge indhold, klippe lyd og vinkle historier
* Være en del af en ambitiøs, sjov og kærlig redaktion
* Finde på de sjoveste interviews til de sejeste kunstnere
* Opleve livemusikken i radioen helt tæt på

Er du interesseret i at komme i praktik hos os, så send os en kort motiveret ansøgning samt dit CV.

Vi forestiller os, at du læser en uddannelse med fokus på medier, journalistik og/eller kommunikation – men i sidste ende går vi meget mere op i dig end i dit CV. Det er dog et krav, at praktikken er meritgivende.

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Praktikken er ulønnet og ca. 37 timer om ugen fra mandag til fredag. Det løber i forårssemesteret 2027 og foregår i DR Byen, der har metro lige til døren. Har du spørgsmål, så skriv til redaktør Simone Kofod Nørgård på snrg@dr.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist: Fredag d. 16. oktober klokken 12.00. Samtaler med potentielle kandidater bliver afholdt i uge 44.

BEMÆRK: Det er en forudsætning, at praktikken er meritgivende. DR skal have dokumentation for dette fra uddannelsesinstitutionen før aftale om praktik kan indgås. Ansøgere kan være universitetsstuderende eller studerende fra andre videregående uddannelser, der har virksomhedspraktik som en del af studieforløbet.

jobs.title: Universitetspraktikant til Verden ifølge Gram
jobs.description_md:
P1-programmet ’Verden ifølge Gram’ søger en akademisk praktikant med stor interesse for og viden om internationale forhold. Du skal gerne væres ambitiøs og ihærdig, og se frem til at gennemføre research af høj kvalitet. Du skal kunne strukturere din tid og din viden. Og så skal du være omhyggelig, da troværdighed og præcision er afgørende for os. Godt humør tæller også højt, og du må gerne grine en del – med mindre internationale begivenheder lægger en dæmper på stemningen.

Din praktik foregår på redaktionen ”Verden ifølge Gram”. Og den er en del af DR-Nyheders store udlandsredaktion, som hver dag producerer nyheder og baggrund til radio, tv og net. Så du lever med i redaktionens redaktionelle liv, journalistiske samtaler og deltager i møder, etc. På ”Verden ifølge Gram” indgår du på lige fod med redaktionens ansatte. Du skal indsamle fakta, relevante lydklip, indkredse mulige gæster til ’Verden ifølge Gram”. Og så skal du være med til at gøre programmet synligt i de sociale medier – bl.a. på LinkedIn. Du skal derfor kunne omdanne komplekst stof til spændende læsestof og udvælge programmets highlights. Og i den verden vi lever og dækker, er dagene travle, så deadlines må ikke give dig stress. Begivenhedernes udvikling skaber behov for fleksibilitet.

Praktikopholdet er ulønnet, og vi regner med, at du er på redaktionen cirka 35 timer om ugen. Vi gør meget ud af at vejlede og udvikle vores praktikanter, og forventer engagement fra din side. Både i det daglige og i samtaler undervejs endevender vi faglige og sociale aspekter af praktiktiden.

Praktikken skal være led i din uddannelse på 30 ECTS. Praktikperioden er fra den 1. februar 2027 og et semester frem efter aftale. Oplæringen sker både med den tidligere praktikant og på kurser i DR. Ansøgningsfrist er fredag den 16. oktober 2026.
Praktikken foregår i DR-Byen, som har metro lige til døren. Du er velkommen til at skrive, hvis du har yderligere spørgsmål. Kontakt den nuværende praktikant Filippa Engholm [fieng@dr.dk](mailto:fieng@dr.dk) eller journalist René Nielsen [ren@dr.dk](mailto:ren@dr.dk)

jobs.title: Intern – Global Public Affairs, Novonesis, Lyngby
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Ready to gain hands-on experience at the world's leading biosolutions company? At Novonesis, our purpose is to better the world with biosolutions. With 10,000 colleagues across more than 45 countries, we develop innovative biological solutions that help feed and fuel the world more sustainably.

As an Intern in the Global Public Affairs team, you will join a young, international team within Global Communications & External Affairs, based in Lyngby, Denmark. The team works closely with regional public affairs colleagues around the world to strengthen policy engagement, support business growth, and position biosolutions with policymakers and key stakeholders.

**The role & your impact**

In this six-month internship, you will gain valuable exposure to international public affairs, policy development, and stakeholder engagement. You will support the team in monitoring policy developments, creating communication tools, conducting research, and preparing insights for senior leaders across the organization.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Monitor relevant policy developments and assess their potential impact on Novonesis.
* Support the creation and launch of public affairs tools, including policy position papers and toolkits.
* Draft policy briefs for Executive Management, Regional Vice Presidents, and Regional Heads of Public Affairs.
* Conduct stakeholder and policy landscape research.
* Help plan outreach activities targeting policymakers and policy influencers.
* Contribute to administrative and coordination tasks supporting the team's activities.

**What you’ll need to be successful in this role**

* Currently studying Political Science, Social Sciences, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* Enrolled in a university programme where the internship is ECTS credit-bearing as part of your degree; students writing their thesis alongside the internship are also encouraged to apply.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing tasks and deadlines.
* A genuine interest in public affairs, policy developments, and stakeholder engagement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language skills are considered an advantage.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

Although not required, experience with public policy processes, government affairs, or policy analysis would be an advantage. We also value candidates who have experience conducting research, stakeholder mapping, or working with complex information. Additional language skills beyond English are welcomed, as is an interest in sustainability, biotechnology, science, or biosolutions. We appreciate individuals who bring a collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to their work.

**What we offer you**

We offer a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a global public affairs function at the world's leading biosolutions company. You will work closely with experienced public affairs professionals, gain exposure to policy discussions and stakeholder engagement across multiple regions, and take ownership of meaningful tasks from day one. As part of a collaborative and international team based at our headquarters in Lyngby, you will build valuable experience that can support your future studies, thesis work, or career within public affairs, communications, and public policy.

**Relevant information**

This is a full-time internship based at our headquarters in Lyngby, Greater Copenhagen, with a duration of six months. The preferred start date is early February 2027, with the internship running until 31 July 2027.

**Application deadline:** Applications must be submitted by **16 October 2026**. Interviews are expected to take place during October 2026.

**Contact:** For further information about the position, please contact Dimitrios Kommatas [**dimko@novonesis.com**](mailto:dimko@novonesis.com).

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).

jobs.title: Student Helper for DTU Student’s Culture Hub - Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs
jobs.description_md:
The Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs is looking for a Student Helper for DTU Student’s Culture Hub.

We are looking for an engaged individual who wants to help Student’s Culture Hub work towards combatting loneliness on campus, creating inclusive mindsets, and supporting our Culture Hub Communities with their activities and events.

**The job**
Tasks include:

* Assisting, guiding and coordination of the existing team of volunteers
* Event creation, development and execution – particularly with a focus on cultural celebrations and social cohesion
* Being the ‘go to’ for knowing what inventory exists in our storage, and being the main person for ensuring it remains catalogued
* General front facing towards DTU students and peers, inspiring them to join our activities and share their stories.

**Our expectations of you**
In order to be considered for the position we require that:

* You have in dept knowledge of DTU Student’s Culture Hub, its communities and activities
* You have previous experience with, or has been a European Solidarity Corps volunteer
* You have a good and thorough understanding of DTU as a university, student life at DTU and are aware of the student political and social landscape
* You have an understanding, experience and fluency in using social media to strengthen outreach of our offers and purpose

**What we offer in return**
DTU Student’s Culture Hub is dedicated to fostering an inclusive, vibrant, and welcoming student environment where all students can feel connected and engaged in campus life.

We work to combat loneliness, strengthen social cohesion, and create opportunities for students from diverse backgrounds to build meaningful relationships and a sense of belonging. Through our communities, events, and volunteer-driven initiatives, we support cultural exchange, student wellbeing, and active participation in university life.

Our activities and services include:

* Organizing and facilitating cultural and social events that bring students together and celebrate diversity.
* Supporting student communities and volunteers in developing and delivering meaningful activities and initiatives.
* Creating opportunities for students to expand their networks, develop new skills, and engage with campus life.
* Promoting inclusion, wellbeing, and a strong sense of community across DTU.
* Engaging directly with students to encourage participation, share information, and raise awareness of available opportunities and support.

By working closely with students, volunteers, and university stakeholders, DTU Student’s Culture Hub contributes to a campus culture where everyone feels welcome, valued, and empowered to participate.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Student Assistant - DTU Compute

* work with course notes in PDF/Markdown and improve retrieval and AI responses
